Default renderer: the stylized counter-kills (the skull wipe and the parchment background) are now drawn by the default renderer itself instead of being handed to the old renderer. That removes a stall of a tenth of a second to two seconds near the end of every one of those kills, which was worst on Macs and low-end PCs. BOTS_N1_COUNTERKILL=port brings back 1.9.2's behavior.
Launcher: the text and buttons are bigger on laptop and high-resolution screens, and Play and Quit stay in view while the settings scroll.
Launcher: the frame rate limit's 30 fps choice now says what it's for: on a computer that can't hold 60, it plays at a steady 30 instead of jumping between 30 and 60.
